company.name: 31 CONCEPT
company.shortDescription: 31 CONCEPT builds ODUN.ONE, a sovereign AI-native Deep Packet Intelligence platform for Tier-1 telecom operators and governments.
company.description:
31 CONCEPT is a Dubai-based deep packet intelligence company. Its flagship platform, ODUN.ONE, replaces legacy Deep Packet Inspection with AI-native Deep Packet Intelligence, restoring visibility for Tier-1 telecom operators and government infrastructure in a world where over 90% of network traffic is encrypted and AI-generated flows are multiplying.

ODUN.ONE follows a four-stage methodology: Observe, Decode, Understand, Navigate. The platform delivers near-complete classification of encrypted and AI-driven traffic, natural-language command and control, real-time subscriber intelligence, threat detection, and new monetization paths from application-aware billing to smart traffic steering. Its architecture is modular, API-first, and microservices-based, runs on standard hardware, and deploys fully on-premises and in-country with no foreign cloud dependency. TrustONE, the platform's data protection layer, extends ODUN.ONE into enterprise data loss prevention and LLM security.

Founded in 2024, 31 CONCEPT raised a $6M pre-seed round and grew from 5 people to more than 50 experts across 14 countries in under eleven months. The company runs ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified processes, holds patent-pending core technology unveiled at ISS Asia 2025, operates production deployments with Tier-1 operators, and acquired Canadian AI security company Xynthor AI in September 2025. Its Research Lab is staffed by professors and PhDs in mathematics, quantum physics, AI/ML, big data analytics, and cryptographic analysis.
